content: vanilla-cookieconsent (orestbida/cookieconsent, MIT license, npm) is a lightweight framework-agnostic consent-banner library with built-in Google Consent Mode v2 support; usable in Next.js as a client component. CookieYes offers a free tier under 5,000 pageviews/mo (ParseForge already exceeds this at 30-50k) then /domain/mo; is also a Google-certified TCF CMP so doubles as both banner AND the ads-compliance CMP requirement.
